title: Read grid editor text through the underlying widget
answers: Why does changing mode or dns_name_servers raise an AttrMap get_text error?
How should the console grid editor read text from a wrapped edit widget?
Where is edited grid text converted back to bytes?
body:
Symptom: Changing string-based console options such as mode or dns_name_servers raises AttributeError: 'AttrMap' object has no attribute 'get_text'.
Root cause: mitmproxy/tools/console/grideditor/col_bytes.py:Edit.get_data called get_text on self._w, which can be an AttrMap wrapper.
Fix pattern: Read text through self._w.base_widget.get_text(), then retain the existing stripping and escaped-string-to-bytes conversion.
Constraints: This pattern applies to text retrieval from the wrapped editor in Edit.get_data; it does not change byte conversion or invalid-input handling.
applies: Console grid editor byte-cell text retrieval, including editing string-based options.
